title: Remove Adjacent Duplicates
statement: Given a string s, repeatedly remove adjacent equal characters and return the result.
think: What is the task asking? Given a string s, repeatedly remove adjacent equal characters and return the result.
What is the key operation? Identify the repeated action over the input.
What wording signals stand out? adjacent duplicates, undo-like, last item.
What is the brute force idea? Use extra loops or repeated checks.
What is the better/optimal idea? Use a clean stack solution.
What are the edge cases? Empty-like input, single values, duplicates, and boundaries.
What is the complexity? For most of these easy tasks, aim for O(n) time unless sorting is required.
How would I explain it in an interview? State the pattern, the key operation, and the complexity.
interview: I would solve it using Stack. I would first identify the core operation, then apply a simple stack approach and mention the complexity.
